import heapq

def pass_route(n: int, edges: list[list[int]], stations: list[list[int]], prices: list[int]) -> int:
    graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for u, v, cost, zone in edges:
        graph[u].append((v, cost, zone))
        graph[v].append((u, cost, zone))

    offers = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for stop, zone in stations:
        offers[stop].append(zone)

    mask_count = 1 << len(prices)
    inf = 10**18
    dist = [[inf] * mask_count for _ in range(n)]
    dist[0][0] = 0
    heap = [(0, 0, 0)]

    while heap:
        cost, node, mask = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if cost != dist[node][mask]:
            continue
        if node == n - 1:
            return cost
        for zone in offers[node]:
            bit = 1 << zone
            if mask & bit:
                continue
            next_mask = mask | bit
            next_cost = cost + prices[zone]
            if next_cost < dist[node][next_mask]:
                dist[node][next_mask] = next_cost
                heapq.heappush(heap, (next_cost, node, next_mask))
        for nxt, ride_cost, zone in graph[node]:
            pay = 0 if zone != -1 and (mask & (1 << zone)) else ride_cost
            next_cost = cost + pay
            if next_cost < dist[nxt][mask]:
                dist[nxt][mask] = next_cost
                heapq.heappush(heap, (next_cost, nxt, mask))

    return -1
